function: Deterministic, MIND-independent multi-cadence projections of append-only Engram records during BODY idle/sleep cycles
capabilities: Produce fast, medium, and slow replayable memory-reference views without an LLM
Detect new Engram records from a verified previous source head
Preserve unmodified source history, provenance references, and exact source-head bindings
adaptation: Use existing NEST/Engram storage and Heart pulses; this is a BODY function, not a mandatory new organ. Adapt a host reader and checked projection publisher only when absent.
verified_with: Synthetic current KPP tests cover actual Engram records, cadence, unchanged-head tier refresh, replay, privacy buckets, tampering and bounds. Host integration and Baker acceptance are separate.
provenance: Adapted from the supplied KPP Pantry proposal, archive SHA-256 029642815c02ac0ed8ca906ccc6412ffc6c006d6f329e3336760bee7f84f969. Its cited Google Research publications are conceptual inspiration.

usage.use_when: The BODY must organize verified experience while the MIND is asleep or unavailable, without rewriting canonical Engram history or creating unnecessary organs.
inputs: Verified bounded complete Engram record prefix
Heart beat number and optional cadences
outputs: Deterministic tiered source-reference projection and delta receipt
Source-bound projection digest without effect authority
usage.limits: Reference handles <=512 records at <=64 KiB each; no semantic summarization, storage writes, API calls, model weight updates, background scheduler, authority, or Baker acceptance. Caller owns permitted reads and durable publication.
